findings.body:
If `path` contains `..` segments the join escapes `/srv/reports` and `send_file` serves arbitrary files on disk.

```suggestion
    p = request.args.get("path", name)
    safe = os.path.normpath(os.path.join(REPORTS, p))
    if not safe.startswith(REPORTS + os.sep):
        abort(400)
    return send_file(safe)
```

summary: The change replaces the `basename` guard with an unsanitized `request.args.get("path")` value passed directly to `send_file`. This introduces a path-traversal vulnerability on a file-serving endpoint.

verification.reason: The head code joins unsanitized `request.args.get("path", name)` under `/srv/reports` and passes it to `send_file`, so `..` segments escape the reports root. The base revision used `os.path.basename(name)`, so this is a real critical path-traversal regression.
